name: LLM Gateway Configuration Orchestrator
summary: Serves as the central management hub for AI model configurations, orchestrating endpoints, compute nodes, and assignment pipelines within the Codrag application. Handles complex state management for endpoint CRUD operations, model testing, HuggingFace integrations, and explicit save semantics for configuration durability.

name: Roadmap Node AI Inspector
summary: Renders detailed inspection views for individual roadmap nodes with integrated AI assistance capabilities for project management workflows. Enables copying node contexts as LLM prompts, executing AI guidance, managing node lifecycle states through promotion and dismissal, and linking to external issue trackers.

name: Epistemic Trace Scoring Engine
summary: Evaluates how well the trace system understands codebase nodes by computing contextual epistemic scores that transcend raw model confidence. Implements a six-component weighted scoring algorithm with decay mechanics and propagation rules to measure true comprehension across the knowledge graph. Defines the specification for contextual understanding metrics within the enrichment pipeline.
tech_debt_summary: Implementation in progress across Pass 2-4 enrichment pipeline stages

name: CoDRAG CLI Documentation
summary: Comprehensive user-facing reference documentation for the CoDRAG command-line interface covering installation, commands, environment variables, and MCP integration workflows. Provides structured examples, exit code references, and troubleshooting guidance for the code indexing and RAG tool.

data_flow: MCP stdin/args -> Child process spawn -> CoDRAG binary execution -> Exit code/signal propagation
name: MCP Protocol Process Bridge
summary: Node.js adapter script serving as an MCP (Model Context Protocol) CLI entry point that spawns the CoDRAG binary with argument forwarding and stdio inheritance. Handles binary resolution errors with installation guidance and propagates exit codes and signals between the MCP ecosystem and the CoDRAG engine.

name: CoDRAG Indexing Configuration
summary: JSON configuration schema defining file inclusion and exclusion patterns for multi-language source code indexing across 50+ programming languages. Configures LLM integration parameters including Ollama local inference endpoints and HuggingFace embedding models, along with project boundaries and feature toggles for the RAG system.

data_flow: Layout persistence state -> DashboardGrid engine -> PanelChrome containers -> AutoHeightPanel measurements -> Batched layout updates
name: Modular Dashboard Layout Engine
summary: Responsive grid layout system that orchestrates dashboard components including adaptive column computation, panel containers, visibility controls, and state persistence. Wraps react-grid-layout to provide centered, dynamically-resizable dashboards with bidirectional layout format conversion and batching mechanisms for auto-height updates.

data_flow: Content DOM mutations -> ResizeObserver/MutationObserver -> Pixel-to-grid conversion -> Parent layout callback
name: Dynamic Grid Height Adapter
summary: Automatically measures content pixel dimensions and converts them to grid units for react-grid-layout integration in dashboard systems. Uses ResizeObserver and MutationObserver to detect content changes and reports calculated grid heights to parent callbacks, solving dynamic content sizing challenges where panels must auto-resize based on their content.

name: Documentation Index Build Controller
summary: Provides a manual interface for triggering documentation index builds by accepting repository root paths and managing the build lifecycle with visual feedback. Renders interactive controls for initiating indexing operations and displays real-time build status through integrated UI components.

data_flow: Captures layout mutations to localStorage with timestamp stamping for conflict resolution, hydrates state on mount, and flushes remaining operations on unload
name: Dashboard Layout Persistence Manager
summary: Manages durable dashboard layout state with automatic localStorage persistence, timestamp-based conflict resolution, and comprehensive panel manipulation APIs. Handles layout migration strategies and ensures data durability through synchronous saves and unload safeguards while providing utilities for dynamic panel reconfiguration.

data_flow: Container components consume business logic hooks for domain data and operations, manage local UI state for forms and transient visibility, and propagate persistence events through callback interfaces to parent orchestrators.
name: Dashboard Shell and Configuration Interface
summary: Orchestrates the CoDrag desktop application's user interface lifecycle and global state management, providing the root component container with health-aware startup flows and visibility-conscious polling mechanisms. Renders ephemeral notification toasts, comprehensive settings drawers for project and global configuration (including license management and deep analysis scheduling), and Tauri-specific auto-update banners with platform-specific installation handling. Integrates with underlying business logic domains through specialized React hooks while managing UI theming, connection health status, and destructive operation confirmations.
